title: Mail Escape Hatch
summary: Verify email exports and keep a portable local archive with every message, attachment, and hash.
user: People leaving or auditing an IMAP provider who need a verified local archive that remains readable, searchable, and attachment-complete outside the mail client.
smallest_useful_product: Desktop app that imports IMAP/Maildir/MBOX, verifies folder/message/attachment counts and hashes, flags OAuth or duplicate anomalies, and writes a portable HTML/EML archive plus manifest.
